constraints: Only one button in a form can have the 'Default button' property; duplicating such a button assigns the property to the copy and removes it from the source.
The keyboard shortcut of the source object is not duplicated; it is left blank on the copy.

If newName is omitted or empty, the copy's name is auto-generated by incrementing the source object's name; if the given/generated name is invalid or already used, the command does nothing and sets the OK system variable to 0.

Cannot be called from an object method's On Load event, from On Unload, or from printing-context form events (e.g. On Header, On Printing Detail); in an unsupported context OK is set to 0, and calling it in a printing context additionally raises error -10601.

overloadMerges.note: The docs render 4 syntax lines = every combination of two independent, order-dependent optional literal '*' flags: a leading '*' (object is a name string vs. a Variable/Field reference) and a trailing '*' (moveH/moveV/resizeH/resizeV are absolute coordinates and become required, vs. optional relative deltas). Collapsed into one overload with both flags modeled explicitly, plus corrected per-param descriptions from the doc table.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, object below is the name of the form object (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference (the first matching object is used if the reference is ambiguous).

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: newVar
params.description: Pointer to variable of new object

params.name: boundTo
params.description: Name of previous enterable object (or radio button)

params.name: moveH
params.description: Horizontal shift of new object (>0 = to the right, <0 = to the left)

params.name: moveV
params.description: Vertical shift of new object (>0 = downwards, <0 = upwards)

params.name: resizeH
params.description: Value of the horizontal resize of the object

params.name: resizeV
params.description: Value of the vertical resize of the object

params.name: useAbsoluteCoordinates
params.description: Trailing '*'. If present, moveH/moveV/resizeH/resizeV are absolute coordinates and all four become required; if omitted, they are optional deltas relative to the source object's previous position/size.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Creates a copy of the form object designated by object in the currently-executing form (Application mode); the source form from Design mode is left unmodified.

jointConstraints.rule: When the trailing '*' (useAbsoluteCoordinates) is passed, moveH, moveV, resizeH, and resizeV all become required and specify absolute coordinates/size for the copy; when omitted, all four remain optional and specify relative deltas from the source object's position/size (0/omitted = superimposed on the source).
